QuestInfo.name: Act 5 - To the Core!
QuestInfo.0: #h0#, along with Brighton, Belle, and Checky, were key in taking the Black Heaven's main deck. The Maple Alliance used this foothold to launch their attack on the Black Heaven. Meanwhile, Orchid is on her way to the Black Heaven after being rescued by Francis. What will become of her and Lotus? And what might Gelimer have up his sleeve?
